layouts.name: Western Speedway
layouts.description: Draft configuration: The independently mapped 2020 main paved oval retains both rounded ends and excludes nearby recreation and motocross courses. Its 531.0 m source centerline matches the catalogue oval identity and remains unscaled against the 538 m timing scalar. The racing team identifies the former Western Speedway venue and its final 2022 event; its advertised 4/10-mile distance differs from this mapped centerline. Historical pavement alignment remains draft. Branch identity was checked against catalogue layout facts and circuit identification references. Independent source distance 531.0 m; no coordinates are changed to match a diagram or distance. Travel direction and historical alignment remain provisional.
